style_when: the story is a product, a device, a price or a market for a thing the reader could buy — an appliance, a panel, a router, a robot arm
prompt: Studio product photograph of a single, massive unbranded heavy-duty GPU compute module resting on a dark, textured slate surface. Off-centre asymmetrical composition with heavy editorial negative space on the left. Shot with a 100mm telephoto lens, sharp focal plane on the brushed aluminum heatsink fins and matte black polymer shroud. A single softbox key light from the upper right casts a long, dramatic contact shadow across the slate. Rich chiaroscuro, catalogue clarity, muted sophisticated palette, deep ambient shadows, no text or printed lettering.
